description: Retrieval evaluation set for the PRISM standards corpus. Each case is a product description of the kind a procurement officer would write, paired with the standard that should be returned. Written to describe the PRODUCT rather than to paraphrase the catalogue title, because every chunk carries its standard's title in the chunk header - scoring against reworded titles would measure string overlap, not retrieval. Some title words are unavoidable and are left in where a real officer would use them.
caveat: These queries were written by an assistant that also proposes the retrieval changes being measured. Treat the numbers as a regression signal, not an independent benchmark, and spot-check a few cases by hand.
hard_cases: The four parts of IS 15449 differ only by General / Accuracy / Sewing / Durability requirements and share a title stem. They are the strictest test in this set and the one closest to the cross-questioning problem.
